d:
Patna siti ke didarganj thana kshetr ke antargat aane vale mirjapur ghat bara hadsa huaa.
Chhath mahaparv ke dauran ganga nadi men snan karne ya arghy dene pahunche char yuvak gahre pani men jane ke karan dub gae. is apratyashit ghatna se ghat par aphrataphri mach gaee aur vahan maujud logon men kohram mach gaya.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
